core_setting: Original PHC pretrained controller on single walking motion
qualitative_result: Good walking imitation; no pain mechanism
decision: Use as visual and metric baseline

core_setting: OA knee load proxy with weak pain reward lambda_p=0.05
qualitative_result: Proxy/reward moved in the right direction but viewer behavior remained close to pretrained
decision: Established that OA load proxy works but weak reward does not produce visible compensation

core_setting: Strong right-knee pain pressure without contact floor
qualitative_result: Right knee load collapsed but policy learned right-leg non-contact/hopping
decision: Showed pain-only pressure creates a cheat instead of clinically useful limping

core_setting: Moderate pain pressure with imitation retained
qualitative_result: Walking remained close to pretrained; standing/start/end could lift the right foot
decision: Identified need to separate walking pain from standing pain and prevent foot-lift cheat

core_setting: Reference-speed pain gate plus right stance contact floor at 120 N and weight 0.50
qualitative_result: Right foot contact recovered but knee load/moment increased
decision: Contact floor was too strong and pulled policy toward normal right loading

core_setting: Softer contact floor at 70 N and weight 0.20 plus stronger moment/KAM/KFM pain
qualitative_result: Right foot contact maintained while knee moment/KAM/KFM decreased; overlay shows visible difference
decision: Current best candidate for pain-aware compensation gait
